GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2012-05-21T13:39:38Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Drawing a simple (open) line
Description: After upgrading to r49 I'm getting errors on some very simple code that draws an open line that goes through several points.

Old code that worked:

``` js
var g = new THREE.Geometry();
g.vertices = [
    new THREE.Vertex(new THREE.Vector3(0,0,0)),
    new THREE.Vertex(new THREE.Vector3(150,0,0))
];
var line = new THREE.Line(g, new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color : 0x0000ff }));
scene.add(line);
```

Now returns:

``` js
THREE.Vertex has been DEPRECATED. Use THREE.Vector3 instead.
TypeError: this.vertices[c].length is not a function
```

My current workaround is to do:

``` js
var points = [
    new THREE.Vector3(0,0,0),
    new THREE.Vector3(150,0,0)
];
var g = new THREE.Shape(points).createPointsGeometry();
```

But that creates a closed shape.

What's the canonical way of drawing a simple, open, line?
